feeds.title: The Shortlist
feeds.description: Petite fashion is finally catching up. Premium clothing exclusively for women 5'3' & under. The News blog labeled Small Talk brings a strong focus to niche lifestyle content for petite women, mixing brand heritage, styling tips, and body-shape advice. It serves dual roles as building brand identity and offering value to their community through styling education.

feeds.title: Dizzybrunette
feeds.description: Corrie, the fashion blogger behind Dizzy Brunette 3. Being 5ft2, Corrie explores pulling off tips and advice for those with petite frames whether it's finding the perfect coat or wearing midi skirts and dresses.
